mapper.sql: select r.rma_id, r.rma_no, r.trace_id, t.trace_code, r.work_order_id, w.work_order_no, s.style_name, r.school_name, r.class_name, r.student_name, r.request_type, r.reason_type, r.old_size_code, r.new_size_code, r.apply_quantity, r.status, r.apply_time, r.receive_time, r.resend_tracking_no, r.conclusion, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from xf_rma_order r left join xf_trace_code t on r.trace_id = t.trace_id left join xf_work_order w on r.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style s on w.style_id = s.style_id
mapper.select:
and r.rma_no like concat('%', #{rmaNo}, '%')
and t.trace_code like concat('%', #{traceCode}, '%')
and r.student_name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
and r.request_type = #{requestType}
and r.status = #{status}
and date_format(r.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(r.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
order by r.apply_time desc, r.rma_id desc
